critical_code_review_comments: Minor: TrainingUpdate schema requires all fields (title/date/location/distance_km/capacity) - PATCH-style partial update not supported, but acceptable since the UI always sends full payload.

Minor: Permanentka effective value is derived as max(0, raw - baseline + adjustment). When admin repeatedly presses 'Vynulovať' and then 'Pridať +N' there is no audit log; consider a dedicated adjustments collection if history/audit becomes a requirement.

Minor: AdjustPermanentkaDialog rejects amount=0 with 'Zadaj počet tréningov' which is correct, but there's no min/max validation server-side; a very large value will be accepted. Non-blocking for an admin-only internal action.
